note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CAR 26-31, 37; A06b CAR 26-31, 37; L05 CAR 46): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Central African Republic, 2024
sources.said: Person has been legally and habitually resident for 5 years. ... n.a. ... Person voluntarily acquires or declares recognition of another citizenship.
